description: The reserved definitions of a Kontra contract document (decisions I2). A document carries each one it uses under exactly this name, byte for byte (after RFC 8785 canonicalisation); the catalog refuses any difference, and seller definitions may not start with Kontra.

KontraArtifact.description: A file in the claim-check bucket, encrypted (age) to the job's parties: a reference, never the bytes. size and sha256 are of the plaintext; a download verifies both.

KontraQuote.description: The answer of the quote operation. ok: a fixed price (amount_minor in the currency's minor unit, e.g. cents) valid for a job of at most max_duration_seconds. rejected: the seller will not take this input, with a reason. busy: try again after eta_seconds.
